What it is

Static comp: frosted-glass testimonial card ('MerchFarm', scalloped badge with interlocking-rings logo, quote) floating over a soft fluid gradient field - orange/violet blobs with faint topographic contour rings and fine halftone grain.

image

Build prompt

Rebuild this static comp 1:1, pixel-faithful: a frosted-glass testimonial card floating over a soft fluid gradient field - orange and violet blobs on a blue-lavender base, thin topographic contour rings at the edges, fine halftone grain over everything.

## Integration
Integration: stack-agnostic spec - every value is plain layout/typography/CSS; recreate with your own components and assets.

## Layout
Square comp. Center: vertical frosted card (white/15 fill, backdrop blur 20px, 1px white/25 border, radius 20). Background: large soft orange and purple blurred blobs over a blue-lavender base, bleeding off the comp edges; thin white contour circles (1px, low opacity) cropped by the upper-left and right edges; uniform halftone grain on top.

## Content
Card holds: "MerchFarm" logo row; a large scalloped seal containing two interlocking rings; a 3-line quote - "Scaled without extra staff. Bocobay cut costs and grew 75 properties with Conduit."

## Typography & color
Quote type large with tight tracking, balanced ragged-right over 3 lines. Palette: orange/violet blobs on blue-lavender; card neutral glass.

## States
Static render (the background reads as liquid but is a still). At most an ultra-slow 60s blob drift if animation is desired - default is none.

## Don't miss
- The glass card genuinely blurs the field behind it (backdrop blur), not a translucent fill fake.
- The scalloped seal with interlocking rings is the focal artifact - build it as vector, not a placeholder.
- Grain is uniform and fine - visible at 100%, invisible at arm's length.
